from rank_bm25 import BM25Okapi
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

emb = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")

def hybrid(query: str, docs: list[str], k: int = {{top_k}}):
    bm25 = BM25Okapi([d.split() for d in docs])
    bm_scores = bm25.get_scores(query.split())
    dv = emb.encode(docs, normalize_embeddings=True)
    qv = emb.encode([query], normalize_embeddings=True)
    vec_scores = (dv @ qv.T).flatten()
    bm = (bm_scores - bm_scores.min()) / (bm_scores.ptp() + 1e-9)
    vs = (vec_scores - vec_scores.min()) / (vec_scores.ptp() + 1e-9)
    final = bm + vs
    idx = np.argsort(-final)[:k]
    return [(docs[i], float(final[i])) for i in idx]
